# Saurav Sharma

> Saurav Sharma is an indie hacker and software engineer who builds SaaS products end to end. His main project is ox, a deployment platform that deploys GitHub repos to your own Ubuntu server with systemd and Caddy, no Docker. Before that he spent five years building Django and Python backends for clients.

## Projects

- [ox](https://deploywithox.com): deployment platform for your own server. Connect a GitHub repo and ox deploys it with zero-downtime releases, rollback, previews per branch and daily backups. Built in Go with HTMX. In beta and free during the beta.
- [ox docs](https://deploywithox.com/docs): how to deploy, configure and operate apps with ox.
- [ox story](https://deploywithox.com/story): why and how ox was built.
- [ox llms.txt](https://deploywithox.com/llms.txt): machine-readable guide to ox for AI agents.
- [LazyPlanner](https://lazyplanner.app): AI planning SaaS, built solo and deployed with ox.
- [Blog](https://blog.sorv.dev): writing on deploys, Django, and building products.
- [Resume](https://sorv.dev/resume.html): work history and skills.
